description: This file defines classes related to a no-operation checkpointer implementation for Orleans streaming with Event Hubs, including a factory class for creating checkpointer instances.

classes.name: NoOpCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating singleton instances of NoOpCheckpointer.

classes.name: NoOpCheckpointer
classes.description: A checkpointer implementation that performs no actual checkpointing, used in scenarios where checkpointing is unnecessary.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and returns a task that results in a singleton NoOpCheckpointer instance.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Returns a task with the start of stream marker, indicating no actual checkpoint data is loaded.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: No-op method to satisfy interface; does nothing.
